svg.aria-label: モルディブの島々を南北に示す地図
svg.metadata: Island positions are rendered in WGS84 local equirectangular fit and calibrated to the official OneMap Maldives island-layer national extent (Geomatics Department / Maldives Land and Survey Authority). GSHHS intermediate-resolution coastlines are generalized only for national-scale legibility. Thin leader lines connect displaced display markers to exact WGS84 coordinate anchors; not for navigation.
